en.headline: Kwai Chung community living room opens as city's 17th
en.dek: Chief Secretary Eric Chan said the 2,300-square-foot centre is expected to serve about 250 subdivided-flat households and 40,000 visits a year.
body: A community living room opened in Kwai Chung on Tuesday, becoming the eighth such centre completed this year, the third in the New Territories and the 17th across Hong Kong. Chief Secretary Eric Chan officiated, saying the project was meant to give subdivided-flat households extra living space and a place to meet neighbours.

The centre has a usable area of about 2,300 square feet. The government said it includes shared cooking, food-preparation and dining space, a children's study and play area, laundry facilities and four bathrooms with showers. It is expected to serve about 250 subdivided-flat households and around 40,000 visits a year.

The New Territories Youth Federation Development Foundation is the lead operator, working with the New Territories Association of Societies social service fund to run the centre around the clock. Chan said Kwai Tsing has many ageing tenement and single-block buildings and cramped subdivided flats, and that the living room was designed around users' needs.

He linked the project to the Policy Address plan for community carer canteens in integrated children and youth services centres outside peak hours, saying both ideas grew from the same approach of finding people who need help and connecting them to services. Organisers said the centre will also circulate welfare information and run interest groups, festival events and neighbourhood gatherings.

zh.headline: 葵涌社區客廳開幕 全港增至十七間
zh.dek: 政務司司長陳國基主持開幕，指二千三百平方呎客廳預計每年服務二百五十個劍房戶、約四萬人次。
body: 葵涌社區客廳星期二開幕，是今年落成的第八間社區客廳，亦是新界區第三間，令全港總數增至十七間。政務司司長陳國基主持典禮，表示項目旨在為劍房戶提供額外生活空間，並讓街坊互相認識。
客廳實用面積約二千三百平方呎，設共享煮食、備餐及用餐空間、兒童學習及遊玩專區、洗衣設備，以及四間淋浴浴室。政府預計每年可服務約二百五十個劍房戶、四萬人次。
主責機構為新界青聯發展基金會，並與新界社團聯會社會服務基金全日營運。陳國基指葵青區不少唐樓及單幢樓樓齡偏高，劍房空間狹窄，客廳在設計上考慮了用家需要。
他提到《施政報告》提出在綜合青少年服務中心非繁忙時段開設社區照顧者飯堂，概念同樣源自社區客廳，都是先找到有需要的人，再把他們連接到服務。營辦單位表示，客廳亦會發放社福資訊，並舉辦興趣小組、節日活動及鄰里聚會。
